name: Vacation Optimizer API
description: Public API endpoints for the Vacation Optimizer planner, showcase, and holiday data. Advertised from the homepage via an RFC 8288 Link header (rel="api-catalog".

endpoints.description: Run the vacation-day optimizer for a country, year, region/state/city, vacation-day settings, custom free days, ignored holidays, monthly caps, locked days, and range constraints.
Total days off for the default 25 vacation days in a country (powers the landing-page country showcase).
Detect the visitor's country from infrastructure headers.
Decode a shared planner seed into calendar day types.
Blog index: title, date, author, summary, tags per post.
